packages.name: @convohop/server
packages.summary: Server SDK for trusted Node.js runtimes: backend-key data-plane calls, management, webhook verification and push requests.

packages.name: @convohop/client

packages.name: @convohop/react
packages.summary: React hooks over the client SDK: conversations with offline-safe sends, typing, session renewal, calls and browser media.
packages.runtime: React 18 or later in current browsers. React Native isn't verified yet.

packages.name: com.convohop:convohop-server

pages.title: ConvoHop SDK documentation
pages.description: Reference documentation, quickstarts and tested examples for the ConvoHop SDKs.

pages.title: TypeScript SDKs
pages.description: @convohop/server and @convohop/client wrap the ConvoHop API for TypeScript and JavaScript. The server SDK runs in your backend with a secret backend key, and the client SDK runs in your users' apps with a short-lived session for one user. @convohop/react adds React hooks over the client SDK, and @convohop/client/push subscribes browsers to Web Push and shows the notifications.

pages.title: TypeScript server quickstart
pages.description: Call ConvoHop from your Node.js backend with @convohop/server: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, and recover a send whose response was lost.

pages.title: TypeScript client quickstart
pages.description: Use ConvoHop in your users' browsers with @convohop/client: connect with the session your backend issued, show a conversation and keep it current, and send messages that survive dropped connections and page reloads. @convohop/react offers the same as React hooks.

pages.title: TypeScript webhooks quickstart
pages.description: Receive ConvoHop events in your backend with @convohop/server: verify each signed delivery, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.

pages.title: TypeScript push notifications quickstart
pages.description: Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: @convohop/server turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and libraries. In browsers, @convohop/client/push subscribes to Web Push and shows the notifications.

pages.title: TypeScript calling quickstart
pages.description: Add voice and video calls to a conversation with @convohop/client: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, and leave or end it.
